summary: The team reviewed status across engineering, design, and marketing ahead of the Q3 launch. Backend payments migration is nearly complete pending a webhook retry fix, the onboarding redesign is ready for engineering review, and the marketing campaign is on track pending final screenshots. The team confirmed the launch date has moved to August 25th and agreed to deprioritize dark mode to the Q4 backlog.
key_decisions: Launch date is officially confirmed as August 25, 2026 (moved from August 20).
Dark mode feature is deprioritized from this release and moved to the Q4 backlog.
discussion_points: Backend migration to the new payments service is roughly 80% complete.
Onboarding redesign screens are ready for engineering sign-off in Figma.
Marketing landing page copy is finalized and the email sequence is drafted, pending final onboarding screenshots.

action_items.task: Fix the webhook retry bug in the payments service migration
Review the new onboarding screens in Figma and give engineering sign-off
Send final onboarding flow screenshots to Karan for the launch email
Update the roadmap doc and notify stakeholders of the new August 25th launch date
Prepare a one-pager summary for leadership covering launch scope and timeline
